Amber — leaning hire-with-conditions.
- Score: 6/10 (modeling 8, infra/scale 5, communication 6)
- Notes: Evan has strong core research chops and an intuitive sense for loss landscapes. However, when pushed on end-to-end design for a multi-tenant inference service he defaulted to data-level fixes rather than caching/lifecycle management — worries me on scale.
- Recommendation: move to offer contingent on 1) short take-home focused on multi-model inference strategy OR 2) 60-min follow-up with infra lead.
